raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. It has three layers: Observe (desktop sensors for work patterns), Intelligence Layer (detects intent, business value, and workflow "drift"), and Execution Layer (Agent Factory for auto-generating, deploying, and monitoring AI agents). The system uses existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to optimize AI assistance in workflows.

core_insight.source_excerpt: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a 'Continuous AI lift.'
core_insight.if_wrong: If enterprises cannot effectively observe work patterns or if AI agent deployment cannot be automated efficiently, Narma will not deliver continuous AI lift or measurable ROI.
core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on an end-to-end system for observing, analyzing, and deploying AI agents using existing foundation models, rather than building new LLMs. Its unique layer-based architecture aims to provide telemetry, ROI measurement, and workflow stability.

raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's innovation is in its integrated, three-layered architecture (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) that leverages existing foundation models to analyze the "Work Graph" of an enterprise, focusing on identifying high-ROI AI automation opportunities and automating agent deployment. This allows for continuous AI optimization and measurable ROI.
raw.thesis: Narma proposes an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" to help AI-first companies identify, validate, and implement AI automation at scale. The innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an "Observe" layer to capture work patterns, an "Intelligence Layer" to detect employee intent and business value, and an "Execution Layer" (Agent Factory) to automatically generate and deploy AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. This system focuses on analyzing the "Work Graph" using existing foundation models to reveal inefficiencies and intervention points for AI, rather than developing new LLMs. Narma is designed for AI-first companies struggle with a lack of telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurement, and workflow drift. The founder’s ambition is to create a continuous AI lift through a single system that observes, decides, and auto-builds agents. The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the founder outlining a conceptual architecture for this sophisticated AI automation platform. Given the current description, it is unclear if the founder's goal is a lifestyle business, growth startup, or moonshot, but the ambition of "continuous AI lift" suggests a growth or moonshot trajectory. Narma complements existing AI solutions by focusing on their deployment and optimization within an enterprise context, rather than competing with foundation models themselves. It sits downstream in the value chain, enabling companies to maximize their investment in AI technologies by providing the missing orchestration and validation layer.
